text_block_list.text: On the way to the Trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If it helps spread marvelousness even further☆
I'll cooperate with anything★

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A cooperative test subject is truly delightful!
Fret not, I will not treat you unfairly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have heard rumors for quite some time. Mysterious
phenomena frequently occur around you, don't they!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In short, we're trying to see if we can quantify
those phenomena and prove them scientifically.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So let's hurry up and measure your brain waves,
pulse, and whatever else.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Sticking all these patches all over me,
it feels really ticklish☆

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Every single value is completely normal. Here I thought
she might be emitting intense Berger waves or something.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fumu. Marvelous-kun.
Could you demonstrate something special for us?
For instance, summoning an unidentified flying object?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I'm great at finding things that are marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
But you see, nobody can predict
when something marvelous is going to happen☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why finding something marvelous
is so incredibly joyful and fun☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm. A conversation that seems coherent yet somehow isn't.
Well, within expectations. Shakur-kun,
bring additional Test Subject B here at once!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? Don't go bossing me around!
(Rattle!)

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous-san! I heard you were here.
I really wanted to thank you!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay! You got your energy back☆
Being able to smile is marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Sample-kun, who testified to experiencing the Marvelous
phenomenon the other day. Please converse
with Marvelous-kun for a while right here.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um, sure. That's fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare take off the measuring devices, got it?
We'll be monitoring from outside.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Look! Test Subject B has entered a sleep state!
What do you make of this, Shakur-kun?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
She certainly looks like she's sleeping...
But vitals, brainwaves, everything's totally normal.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's no different from when she's awake.
What the hell is going on? Is she playing possum?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating.
Well then, let us conduct a Q&A!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, while we were talking, it felt like
I was having a wonderful dream.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh☆
It was a super marvelous dream, wasn't it★

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yet we have captured not a single record
that objectively demonstrates it...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Looks like we're at a dead end, huh?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's not true at all☆

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You see, marvelousness is
noticing what is precious all around you☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So discoveries, successes, and even failures—
every single bit of it is marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kuku. Being immeasurable is also a discovery in itself.
...So that is what you call marvelous, eh?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Exactly☆ There are soo many wondrous things out there★
That's why the world is always marvelous☆
